steps.what: Sum budgets, equipment, and performance rows
Incorporate technical considerations into design plans
Check figures and the privacy and legal issues

outputs: filed copy of signed design plan v1

tasks.design: The scheduled accessibility check already runs in {CMS}. A job sums budgets, equipment, and performance rows in {BI}. The developer incorporates those technical considerations into the design plans and checks each figure, including privacy and legal issues. A later job files the signed plan in {DOCS}. The design does not treat the firm as in scope and does not add a log that watches named staff.
tasks.previous_blocker: Budget and equipment figures were copied into the plan by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Budget line, equipment identifier, and performance value are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The plan is still written by the developer.
tasks.human_edge: The developer decides what the figures mean for the plan.
tasks.altitude: The developer spends the week on the plan, not on summing the rows.

reach.task: Read only the signed design plan
reach.learn: Which budget line a figure uses

evidence.claim: The executive digest says scheduled link and accessibility checks already run.
Digest [S16] says a Dutch cyber duty applies from 15 August 2026. This design does not treat the firm as in scope.
Digest [S22] says logging is limited to what is strictly necessary and proportionate.
Digest [S23] says works-council consent is required before logs or a dashboard observe staff.

assumptions: Budget line, amount, equipment identifier, performance value, and accessibility result are stored on the report record. The report record produces them. A blank amount stays blank and is not written as zero.
Native configuration of the report record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the developer signed is filed or sent.
The plan does not add a log of named staff. Consent to observe staff is a separate decision. The design does not file a cyber report.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining writing time is still the developer incorporating the considerations.

incremental.description: Refresh budget line, equipment identifier, and performance value when the report layout changes, and drop a plan the developer has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many budget lines are blank. The high end assumes budget line, equipment, and performance value are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The web developer spends the week writing, reviewing, and merging. A stored failing check, a blank field, and filing a signed note can move. The developer still reviews every change, and no job changes a live system alone.
reach: A reviewer reads the change before the developer merges it.
A specialist receives only the notice the developer signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a list that is missing a stored field.
Reject a sentence that does not restate a stored row.
Reject a live change that is not the signed set.
role.ambitious_version: A signed change can be filed the same week, and the developer still owns the merge.
